author: Jincheng Liu
scope: Engineering reproducibility and data-governance patch release preserving all frozen scientific outcomes, with cross-platform publication closeout and forward-only governed data-intake corrections
claim_boundary: No Hithium internal data are included
Results are retrospective development results on public data
The primary tau value is post-hoc
Independent long-duration LFP validation remains pending
No 15-25 year product-accuracy claim is permitted
Passing the adversarial implementation audit does not confirm the model
The public-data evaluation unit is 17 condition-mean trajectories
The p=10 landmark is retrospective signal only, not a confirmed earliest landmark
V4 intervals are retrospective diagnostics and operational issuance remains zero
The 210 V4 partitions overlap and are sensitivity enumerations, not independent coverage trials
The Geisbauer result is a negative 120-day stress screen, not long-term validation
Geisbauer 8/7 cell directions use numerical zero; post-hoc equivalence margins are exploratory, not engineering gates
The 15 Geisbauer leave-one-cell-out scenarios overlap and are not independent replications
No currently qualified public dataset supports independent long-term LFP trajectory confirmation
The long-term protocol is a draft preregistration asset, not a validation result
The calendar-prefix interface is a public condition-mean research demo, not a deployed product or individual-cell service
Calendar-prefix request v1 is restricted to the calibrated p=10 Naumann grid and rejects 15-25 year coordinates
Schema-valid prefixes without local stress-slice support or outside the locked joint residual limits receive no numeric prediction
The Judge Console is deterministic retrospective evidence replay, not live model inference
Adding an inference interface and console does not increase the evidence grade of the underlying model
The preregistered synthetic long-horizon V1 result is failure, with one of three primary endpoints passing
The synthetic stress test does not validate real LFP cells, Hithium products, storage stations, or 15-25 year accuracy
The post-hoc v0.15 logistic risk-head analysis is hypothesis generation on exposed partitions, not confirmation
The implementation-frozen V0.15 synthetic V2 attempt is post-release development and is not part of the immutable v0.14 evidence release
No formal V2 result existed at implementation freeze; implementation integrity does not imply a successful experimental outcome
The frozen V2 pre-prediction training-failure artifact rules are internally incomplete, so the implementation fails closed rather than fabricating downstream commitments
NASA evidence-weighted V3 is retrospective development on four exposed accelerated cycle-aging cells, not LFP or independent confirmation
FastCharge trajectory V1 failed its primary MoE development gate; the failure remains part of the public record
FastCharge safe-prior V2 froze cycle-300 predictions before scoring cycles 201-300 but remains post-V1 development on an outcome-exposed public cohort
The FastCharge V2 safe hard selector is a promising retrospective candidate, not an independently confirmed production model
FastCharge source content hashes are incomplete and the Table 9 identity crosswalk is source-derived rather than a direct author assertion
The safe hard transfer candidate was nominated after development outcomes were exposed and is not an independent confirmation
A ready metadata intake is only permission to begin manual dataset-specific freeze review, not a frozen protocol or validation result
The independent intake compiler accepts no measurement-value fields and never freezes a protocol automatically
